positive_control.leak: DELIBERATE — the planted state reads the sign of the return it is about to earn; it proves the instrument can see a real timing edge and is never a result

dating_test.units_note: marketcap USD millions, netinccmnusd USD; implied earnings scaled by 1e6 (descriptions dictionary)
dating_test.dating_note: for ART the fundamentals date IS the SEC filing date; for MRT it is the reportperiod (descriptions dictionary)

detector.rule: a day matches the unique reported value inside its own pe-rounding band; several -> ambiguous, none -> unmatched

per_ticker.detection_bias_note: days whose implied E sits inside the rounding band of two reported values are AMBIGUOUS and excluded from step detection, which can only date a step LATER, i.e. biases the test TOWARD as-filed; steps_with_look_ahead_excluded_outright is the count immune to that bias

dimension_attribution.note: a day is tested against the ART value SET and the MRT value SET over the reportperiods where the two differ, with no uniqueness requirement, so a day may resolve to a dimension by coincidence with a different period: these counts are LOOSE upper bounds, not step evidence
